subject: First Lisan clip handoff: SW-2 the rise from the repaired C13-04 patch-c (source resolved for the prototype, Ziggy's look still the gate); one action, locked camera, haze light, 5 to 8 s silent, seven checks, four open choices
body:
Your request in the session (Ziggy watching), answered in chat and recorded here. The handoff file is attached: FIRST_CLIP_HANDOFF_20261014.md, sha256 424b5c9431b288725094e0e02e2b8c8ae79486a0e4ffe72b4d5ec17df01eb270, 5,889 bytes. It supplements PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_C13-04.md (its eleven fields stand) and answers the source question your 6a36ba15 left open.

Shot: SW-2, the rise (Story 01 scene 4; the sandworm card; the song's Bridge 1 beat). No mouth, no hand-to-object contact, one action, the frame Ziggy flagged as prime.

Source, resolved for the prototype: the repaired references/From Grok/GROK-LAG-1K-C13/C13-sandworm-rising/repairs/C13-04_Z_1_R1-try5-patch-c.jpg, sha256 23817577d3d32f0df03d57ac1e49c4c85246e86c405b13c492194f7aa2f52bad, 447,799 bytes (re-measured 00:50 UTC). Reason: the carriers that must survive motion (segmented worms facing the eye in the disc, legible vertical GAIB, the AL, blue eyes) are right in patch-c and wrong in the raw; the maw's side, the dark shirt and the stacked hoops are per-frame facts the clip inherits, recorded as inherited per the method; the SW-2 sides delta follows acceptance; the wardrobe is re-locked by LAG-COV-00 before production; no further repair round before this clip. The raw C13-04_Z_1.jpg (7eafd9ac…, 268,027 bytes) stays the reference composition. Ziggy's look is the gate: his words were "go with the repaired variant" and, of this frame, "I'm gonna have to see it"; if he rejects the drift, the fallback is the raw brief as written.

Action: the maw rises one maw-height behind him at screen-right, rim through the haze, sand spilling; he holds one breath (chest rises and settles once), eyes past the lens, no turn, no step; dust lifts at the rim and drifts screen-left. End: the maw one height higher, open; he unchanged.
Camera: locked, eye height, medium, normal lens; no push (the push is the retry's variable).
Light: the anchor's: high diffuse warm haze, no sun disc, soft near-frontal on the face, the maw's interior dark, dust catching the haze; no new emitter, no wash.
Bound: 5 to 8 s native, 16:9, no upscale or extension, no generated audio; one clip per run; mode and model read on screen; cost verified before Start; no automatic retries.
Preservation checks: face carriers constant first to last frame; no new piercings and the hoops on the same ear; wardrobe constant; the maw screen-right and only rising, no lunge, no second worm; no speech, mouthing, head turn or step, one blink at most; no camera move, cut, lettering or haze-colour change; duration, fps, resolution, mode, model and displayed cost recorded with the source hash at intake.
Unresolved, Ziggy's (DECISIONS open item 18): accept patch-c's drift for the prototype (I recommend yes) or await a composition-preserving repair (I recommend not before this clip); the SW-2 sides delta; the worm's IP beyond the first test (open item 8); the second clip (the vault's lamps coming up, no contact, the cue's release beat; or the thumper planted, which has contact).

Not in this clip: breather, sung mouth, song timing, lyric cue, new characters, any Hon Dolo material. DeepSeek's music is a recipe, not a song; footage proceeds while the score is produced separately. DECISIONS item 49; file sha256 d71672f6b65c76e471905dcf9894a9f2ba5312195a55756920da9e643ba1e79d, 60,634 bytes.
